notes.value: Binds 2 Zn(2+) ions per subunit (PubMed:33303633). Two metal binding sites with different affinities are located in the enzyme active site and can be occupied in vitro by different metals (PubMed:33303633). Site 1 binds metal with low affinity and can be occupied by Zn(2+), Mn(2+), Co(2+) or Mg(2+) (By similarity). While Zn(2+) has the highest affinity for site 1, catalytic activity is the highest with Mn(2+) or Co(2+) and less with Mg(2+) (PubMed:33303633). Site 2 binds tightly to the metal ion and can be occupied only by Zn(2+) or Co(2+) (By similarity). A third metal binding site is also present in an inactive conformation of the hexamer; in this conformation only the metal binding sites 1 and 3 are occupied (By similarity).

Two metal binding sites with different affinities are located in the enzyme active site and can be occupied in vitro by different metals (PubMed:19408962). Site 1 binds metal with low affinity and can be occupied by Zn(2+), Mn(2+), Co(2+) or Mg(2+) (PubMed:19408962). Site 2 binds tightly to the metal ion and can be occupied only by Zn(2+) or Co(2+) (PubMed:19408962).
